# zlib / example_dict_fuzzer

OSS-Fuzz's fuzz target `example_dict_fuzzer` ([source](source/example_dict_fuzzer.c), unmodified) over zlib 1.4 (madler/zlib at 99623ef7).

Checks 2 properties (listed below); the first, a round trip: deflateInit2 (level/windowBits/memLevel/strategy from data[0]) with a preset dictionary = first data[0] bytes of the input, then inflate supplying the dictionary on Z_NEED_DICT; output memcmp-compared with the input. A mismatch only prints and returns 0.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against zlib 1.4 at commit 99623ef7.
- zlib carries the public inflate fix https://github.com/madler/zlib/pull/1390 in every build.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
- deflate(Z_FINISH) must report Z_STREAM_END; the dictionary id inflate asks for must equal the Adler-32 recorded after deflateSetDictionary; every other call Z_OK (CHECK_ERR). All print + return 0 ([lines 79-123](source/example_dict_fuzzer.c#L79-L123)): prints only; confirmed in the binary.
- deflateInit2 (level/windowBits/memLevel/strategy from data[0]) with a preset dictionary = first data[0] bytes of the input, then inflate supplying the dictionary on Z_NEED_DICT; output memcmp-compared with the input. A mismatch only prints and returns 0 ([lines 129-132](source/example_dict_fuzzer.c#L129-L132)): prints only; not confirmed in the binary.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch zlib` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `example_dict_fuzzer.plain` | 98,048 | `33e3a6584ba195f8843f86e1ddd07275577373cf08f439f70e7a4e661741fa02` |
| ubsan | `example_dict_fuzzer.ubsan` | 110,448 | `7d8b097d70ddf4a5d49732ae33139bc0044b358c37397a3cd544042852bc0a5f` |
| asan | `example_dict_fuzzer.asan` | 718,952 | `a4853211643e20182542300930c6f5f9f93c05c1feeafdecd0557869fd702ac6` |
| asan-ubsan | `example_dict_fuzzer.asan-ubsan` | 729,960 | `bff4c2ace624a312aa912dfbcd24be0b86769889f039fa3edb019fff97b5a650` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
